premises.text: Africa faces a shortage of developers, with less than 1% of school children leaving school with basic computer science knowledge
premises.evidence_span: Less than 1% of African school children leave school with basic knowledge of computer science

premises.text: A gamified app teaches programming fundamentals via game puzzles and graphical programming blocks that are easy and intuitive for kids
premises.evidence_span: bBlocky lets children learn the fundamentals of computer programming through game puzzles

premises.text: The app works fully offline so it remains usable where internet penetration is low
premises.evidence_span: our application works fully offline, ensuring inclusivity in regions where internet penetration is very low

premises.text: Augmented reality lessons make learning more interactive than competitors focused on US/Europe desktop or internet-dependent tools
premises.evidence_span: It leverages the cutting-edge augmented reality technology to make the learning process much more fun and very interactive

premises.text: Revenue comes from an in-app toy store for characters plus branded-character placements for companies
premises.evidence_span: Our primary source of revenue is in-app toy store, where we allow our users to purchase different game characters in our toy store

value.text: Children become creators of technology by learning coding fundamentals in a fun, accessible way
value.evidence_span: These children need not only be passive consumers of technology, but also become creators and innovators of it

secondary_value.text: Inclusivity for regions with low internet penetration expands who can learn
secondary_value.evidence_span: ensuring inclusivity in regions where internet penetration is very low

causal_links.evidence_span: shortage of developers, the real architect of this digital economy
learn the fundamentals of computer programming through game puzzles
purchase different game characters in our toy store

notes: Download counts and market growth rates treated as traction/framing. Course feature list (algorithms, free roaming, coins) folded into the core gamified-learning premise (v1.3.2 #5).
